systems.tiers: administrative numbers (issued 2014) distinct from the national number

LBY.note: No exchange of records between civil register and national number system stated.
Gives no count or share of people holding a national number; only about 17,000 families on administrative numbers and activists' claim of over 60,000 without proof of nationality or a number.
No operator or owner of the system stated.

facts.fact: The UN-backed advisory committee recommends limiting candidacy and voter registration in elections to holders of the national number, which administrative-number holders criticise.

The article describes a national number in use as the basis for political and civil rights, with the Public Prosecution saying 291 national numbers must be struck off after checking 10,620 family records.
